prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. We'll keep identifying details out of the transcript. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving east on a two-lane road in Katy, heading toward the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon, and traffic was light.
Q: What happened right before impact?
A: A car came over the center line into my lane. I braked and turned right, but it hit me head-on anyway, though not very hard. It was more of a scrape than a crash, honestly.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes. The airbags didn't deploy. I got out of the car on my own and walked to the curb.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I've had a headache since that day, and my head feels foggy. Bright lights bother me, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?
A: I think I hit the side window, or maybe the headrest. I didn't lose consciousness, but I felt dazed for a few minutes.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening, and they told me I might have a concussion. I've been referred to a neurologist, and I have an appointment next week.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the symptoms?
A: I took two days off and I'm working reduced hours now. My employer has been understanding, but I still get tired by mid-afternoon.
Q: Is there anything else you think we should know?
A: Only that I'm trying to take it easy and follow my doctor's instructions. I'd appreciate updates on the claim when you have them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
